[FACT] User is currently driving a Honda Civic.

[EVENT] User is considering buying a new car.  
[EVENT] User is seeking information about the maintenance costs of the Toyota Camry and Honda Accord.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Both the Toyota Camry and Honda Accord are known for their reliability and low maintenance costs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Average annual maintenance cost for Toyota Camry: $321.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Average repair frequency for Toyota Camry: 0.3 times per year.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Average repair cost for Toyota Camry: $341.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Scheduled maintenance costs for Toyota Camry:  
- Oil changes: $25-$35  
- Tire rotations: $20-$30  
- Brake pad replacements: $200-$300  
- Belt replacements: $50-$100  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Average annual maintenance cost for Honda Accord: $362.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Average repair frequency for Honda Accord: 0.4 times per year.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Average repair cost for Honda Accord: $384.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Scheduled maintenance costs for Honda Accord:  
- Oil changes: $25-$35  
- Tire rotations: $20-$30  
- Brake pad replacements: $250-$350  
- Belt replacements: $50-$100  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Honda Accord generally has slightly higher maintenance costs than the Camry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional factors to consider for maintenance costs include model year and trim level, driving conditions, maintenance schedules, and dealership vs. independent mechanic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Average brake pad replacement interval for Toyota Camry: 30,000 to 50,000 miles, with some models up to 70,000 miles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Average brake pad replacement interval for Honda Accord: 30,000 to 50,000 miles, with some models up to 60,000 miles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Signs that indicate it's time to replace brake pads include squealing or grinding noises, spongy brake pedal, vibrations when braking, low brake pad warning light, and visual inspection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips to extend brake pad life include avoiding aggressive driving, driving smoothly, avoiding carrying heavy loads, and using the correct brake fluid.
